In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (侵犯注册商标专用权罪) under Article 210 of Criminal Law. The description: manufacturing, selling counterfeit goods with registered trademark without permission. So charge: 侵犯注册商标专用权罪.

Check companion charges list: only "信用卡诈骗" and "票据诈骗". Not relevant.

Thus answer single charge: [侵犯注册商标专用权罪] (or "侵犯注册商标专用权罪").
